landing.meta_description: DisvorAI turns a domain into AI visibility reports, action tickets, verification results, and client delivery packs.
landing.title: DisvorAI | From domain to verifiable AI visibility action
landing.hero_copy: From one domain, generate verifiable AI visibility reports, tickets, and delivery packs.
landing.truth_title: State what was measured before talking growth.
landing.truth_body: Model knowledge comes from weights only—no live search or external retrieval. Web-grounded and manual product-surface results are labeled separately.
landing.truth_engines_dd: Unified access to GLM, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and more
landing.truth_sampling_dd: API and manual product-surface results share one report
landing.workflow_body: Diagnosis, execution, and review share one evidence-backed workflow.
landing.workflow_1_body: Crawl the site, infer brand facts, competitors, and prompts. Unconfirmed items stay marked pending.
landing.workflow_2_body: Check crawlability, structure, extraction blocks, and authority signals, then sample configured engines.
landing.workflow_3_body: Organize an action plan by impact and effort into tickets with owners and acceptance criteria.
landing.workflow_4_body: Re-crawl and compare samples. Passes close automatically; regressions reopen.
landing.workflow_5_body: Ship diagnosis, plan, tickets, verification, assets, and a client delivery pack.
landing.product_title: Evidence and next steps on one screen.
landing.product_body: Every score maps to a page gap; every gap maps to action and verification.
landing.shot_audit_cap: Gaps link to pages and tickets
landing.shot_report_cap: Outputs for leaders, teams, and clients
landing.ops_body: Tenant workspaces built for agencies, consultants, and brand teams.
landing.ops_byok_dd: API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and injected only while jobs run.
landing.ops_tenant_dd: Project artifacts are stored per tenant; members use owner, editor, and viewer roles.
landing.ops_ssot_dd: Audits, tickets, metrics, and packs stay inspectable files; the database stores indexes and metadata only.
landing.ops_enterprise_dd: OIDC SSO and audit events. Technical controls are ready; DisvorAI is not SOC 2 certified.
landing.pricing_body: Use your own model keys by default. Subscriptions do not hide sampling cost.
landing.pricing_note: No guarantee of mention or ranking. AI answers are noisy; trends need multiple sampling rounds.
landing.faq_1_q: Do API samples match what users see in the product UI?
landing.faq_1_a: Most APIs measure model knowledge, not live product search. DisvorAI labels each engine as API · Model knowledge, API · Web-grounded retrieval, or Manual · Product surface.
landing.faq_2_q: Must I bring my own model API keys?
landing.faq_2_a: BYOK is the default. Configure only the engines you plan to use; others are skipped and shown as unmeasured.
landing.faq_3_q: Can results guarantee the brand is mentioned by AI?
landing.faq_3_a: No. The product provides traceable diagnosis, execution guidance, and before/after comparison—not ranking or mention promises. Answers are noisy; use multi-round trends.
landing.faq_4_q: What is included in the 14-day trial?
landing.faq_4_a: The trial supports 3 projects, up to 2 sampling runs each, plus reports, tickets, verification, and delivery packs.
landing.faq_5_q: Is it suitable for agency client delivery?
landing.faq_5_a: Yes. Agency includes 30 active projects, team roles, white-label headers, and downloadable packs.
landing.final_title: Turn AI visibility into executable, verifiable work.
landing.footer_tagline: AI visibility diagnosis, execution, and delivery.
